decisions.reason: Press-to-dispense operation does not change the existing requirements for sealing the spout and protecting the base and electronics from leaks.
The source does not change the spout location, orientation, appearance, construction material, or beverage-quality constraints.

The client asks whether the spouts will be removable and notes the cleaning benefit, but it is unclear whether this narrows the existing removable-or-flush cleaning method to mandatory removability or merely requests confirmation.
Button-operated dispensing does not alter the platform height, cup clearance, configuration, or mixer fit.
The interaction choice does not necessarily change the current V1 priority or the established custom-spout sourcing policy.
The source specifies a dispensing interaction but does not revise the approved component set, BOM deliverables, compatibility checks, or need for additional components.
Press-to-dispense operation does not change the required mixing texture, foam consistency, or high-speed mixing behavior.
The source discusses removable spouts rather than bowl removal, swapping, or clearance from the whisk and motor assembly.
The source does not modify the splash target, guard policy, or high-speed splash mitigation requirements.
